verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de offers a public REST API for notarization, incorporation and tax registration, so scoped API credentials are a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence describes issuing API keys with limited scopes, permissions or least-privilege restrictions. The HMAC webhook signing secret is a related security feature, not scoped API credentials, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
